```python
n = int(input().strip())
x = int(input().strip())

# The swaps repeat every 6 moves.
cycle = n % 6

# Simulate the swaps on the final position backwards by running
# the same cycle forward from all possible starting positions.
# But easier: simulate forward for each possible start and see which matches x.
def final_pos(start, moves):
    pos = start
    for i in range(moves):
        if i % 2 == 0:  # odd move number (1-based): swap 0 and 1
            if pos == 0:
                pos = 1
            elif pos == 1:
                pos = 0
        else:  # even move number: swap 1 and 2
            if pos == 1:
                pos = 2
            elif pos == 2:
                pos = 1
    return pos

for start in range(3):
    if final_pos(start, cycle) == x:
        print(start)
        break
```

```python
n = int(input().strip())
x = int(input().strip())

# The pattern of positions for each starting shell repeats every 6 moves.
# Precompute where each starting position ends up after k moves for k in [0..5].
pattern = [[0]*6 for _ in range(3)]
for start in range(3):
    pos = start
    pattern[start][0] = pos
    for move in range(1, 6):
        if move % 2 == 1:  # odd move: swap 0 and 1
            if pos == 0:
                pos = 1
            elif pos == 1:
                pos = 0
        else:  # even move: swap 1 and 2
            if pos == 1:
                pos = 2
            elif pos == 2:
                pos = 1
        pattern[start][move] = pos

k = n % 6
for start in range(3):
    if pattern[start][k] == x:
        print(start)
        break
```
